items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: he and BAB Wilbur were both playing soprano

ctx.x: There was a boy called Kenny DAUSBN, plays clarinet; they had what they called Soprano -- he and BAB Wilbur were both playing soprano (Soprano Summit+--ed.) saxophones. And somebody told me that he was playing C melody. I just wondered what sort of sound he'd get on it.
C melody could be maybe a beautiful instrument, but it's not a known instrument to jazz musicians today. And nobody's ever thought of it. It could be an instrument maybe today that might be superb.
